newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-USX-Marathon year EPS raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-USX-Marathon year EPS raised.

text.p: NEW YORK, July 23 (Reuter) Deutsche Morgan Grenfell raised its 1997 earnings per share estimate for USX Marathon Group by 10 cents to $2.10 in response to a second quarter earnings surprise of $0.55 per share compared with a First Call forecast of $0.48.
"A 16 percent decline in upstream earnings to $179 million pretax was offset by a 31 percent increase in refining and marketing results which reached $165 million pretax," said analyst Michael Young.
Young expects refining and marketing strength to continue into the third quarter.
He also raised his cashflow per share estimate by 10 cents to $4.40 per share.
